protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: Confirmed. In UsersController::edit, org/group administrators can POST role_id because it is added to the CRUD fields whitelist. The self-id conjunct added by 5aefc3783746199f8259fa0e7d2d4b1ba5321def suppresses both the privileged-role afterFind rejection and the beforeSave role-assignment rejection for self-edit, so an out-of-policy role_id is patched into and saved on the caller's own user. The later dropdown mutation cannot protect the closures because validRoles was captured by value. The advisory also names organisation_id, but the cited direct fix changes the role_id self-edit bypass; the primary correctly confines its causal claim to that proven path.
protocol_checks.atomic_bic: Confirmed. git log -S for the self-id conjunct identifies 5aefc3783746199f8259fa0e7d2d4b1ba5321def as its first write. The commit is a coherent self-edit change across UsersController, ACLComponent, and the users index: it enables self-edit UI/ACL access while adding the two vulnerable authorization exceptions. Later 04322b24dfd65934c4b13ecc7ac269d3109ee223 adds fields/isset guards but preserves the self-id exception, so it is not the BIC.

Its UsersController::edit applies both validRoles checks unconditionally and contains no self-id conjunct; the pre-existing beforeSave control traces to b41b0dd712c5b9cddaaf5d2103566c56e17ce2ad.
